# En Boca de Todos Mexican Food

> Family-run Mexican restaurant at 703 S Terrell St, Midland, Texas 79701, serving breakfast and lunch. Known for breakfast burritos from 6 a.m., chilaquiles, guisados, café de olla served in a clay jarrito, and menudo and pozole on weekends. Order by phone: (432) 218-7078 or (432) 218-7079.

Hours (Central time): Tuesday to Saturday 6 AM to 2 PM; Sunday 7 AM to 2 PM; closed Monday.
Weekend soups: menudo and pozole Friday to Sunday; caldo de res Saturday and Sunday.
Rated 4.5 stars on Google. The website is in English and Spanish.

- [Home](https://en-boca.com/): menu, house favorites, weekend soups, hours, directions and Google reviews

- [Breakfast burritos in Midland](https://en-boca.com/breakfast-burritos-midland)
